title: The Grand hall of the school
subtitle: 工程建造 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 工程建造（科学与技术·工程与建造）
meta: 主题语境：工程建造（科学与技术·工程与建造）　|　核心词汇：grand　|　正文 339 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 grand 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1976 the guide wrote of ① a grand hall of the school in the guidebook, and everybody in the valley said at once that it was ② grander than the one named there the year before. Three days on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the guide, who never explained anything, had done it without a word of thanks and gone home; it was the grand ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the grandest hall of the school anybody in the valley had ever seen, or so the guidebook for July 1970 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too grand to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the traveller who had come to help; the grand ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the map at the far ledge, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a grand plan for the bridge, and said that no traveller in his right mind would call it ⑥ as grand as the plan for the bridge they had once had in the old valley. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was grand or not, and he said so.

By 1983 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the guidebook. What the line asked for was ⑦ something grand, and nothing besides. The traveller from the next valley called the whole plan ⑧ quite grand; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the guidebook kept the names of the grand ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1986, at once, she wrote of another grand hall of the school in the same guidebook, and the work, which took two days, seemed ⑨ grander than anybody had expected. ⑩ The grandest plan for the bridge in the whole valley, she said in 1988, was the one she could never quite name; the grand ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 宏大（前置定语 a grand hall of the school：1976 年向导在旅行手册里记下的那件宏大的大厅）
B. adj. 宏大／壮丽（比较级 grander than：文中两处，一处比学校的大厅，一处比预想）
C. adj. 宏大／壮丽（最高级 the grandest：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 宏大（表语 too grand to do：母亲觉得它太宏大，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 壮丽（前置定语 a grand plan for the bridge：叔叔把整件事称作一桩壮丽的宏大计划）
F. adj. 壮丽（同级比较 as grand as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩造桥的宏大计划相比）
G. adj. 壮丽（后置定语 something grand：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 壮丽（受程度副词修饰 quite grand：那位旅人的评价）

items.q: a grand hall of the school
the grandest hall of the school anybody
a grand plan for the bridge
The grandest plan for the bridge in

answers.why: grand 意为“宏大”，1976 年向导在旅行手册里记下的是“一件宏大的大厅”，此处作前置定语 a grand hall of the school。
grand 意为“宏大”，此处用比较级 grander than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
grand 意为“宏大”，旅行手册上 七月 那行字说它是山谷里最宏大的一件，故用最高级 the grandest hall of the school。
grand 意为“宏大”，母亲认为这件东西“太宏大了，谁也用不上”，too grand to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
grand 意为“壮丽”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩壮丽的宏大计划”，此处作前置定语 a grand plan for the bridge。
grand 意为“壮丽”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩造桥的宏大计划一样壮丽”，同级比较用 as grand as。
grand 意为“壮丽”，旅行手册上那半行字要的是“壮丽的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something grand。
grand 意为“壮丽”，邻山谷来的那位旅人认为这套计划“相当壮丽”，quite 修饰原级 grand。
grand 意为“壮丽”，1986 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要壮丽”，故用比较级 grander than。
grand 意为“壮丽”，母亲 1988 年说的是“整个山谷里最壮丽的那一桩”，故用最高级 the grandest plan for the bridge。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1976 年，向导在旅行手册里记下了一件宏大的大厅。（a grand hall of the school）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更宏大。（grander than …）
母亲觉得它太宏大，谁也用不上。（too grand to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩壮丽的宏大计划。（a grand plan for the bridge）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩造桥的宏大计划一样壮丽。（as grand as …）
到了 1983 年，旅行手册上只剩半行字：要的是一件壮丽的东西。（something grand）
answers: In 1976 the guide wrote of a grand hall of the school in the guidebook.
Everybody said it was grander than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too grand to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a grand plan for the bridge.
He said nobody would call it as grand as the plan for the bridge they had once had.
By 1983 the guidebook asked for nothing but something grand.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 grand 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1976 the guide wrote of a grand hall of the school in the guidebook, and nobody forgot it.
It was the grandest hall of the school in the valley, or so the guidebook says.
My mother thought it too grand to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a grand plan for the bridge, and nobody argued with him.
The traveller from the next valley called the plan quite grand, and everybody laughed.
The grand ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
